title: Alpha Feedback 15 October
description: UI fixes from the public alpha feedback not covered by the earlier batches (W1-W8, E1-E3). Plague's planet chips show infantry (fb_1792038952), a commander or hero unlock toasts its printed ability to every seat (fb_1792039768), and the lobby page has a Back to start button (fb_1791875585). Before shots were taken on consolidated-2026-10-15 (8a18ebc8) with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before and moved to before/; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- EG. Mocked fixtures.

shots.heading: Before: Plague planet chips
shots.caption: Each candidate planet shows resources and influence, which Plague ignores.

shots.heading: After: Plague planet chips
shots.caption: Each chip says how many infantry stand there (Jord 4, Exhausted World 1): that is what Plague rolls for.

shots.heading: Before: a commander unlocks
shots.caption: The state says Claire Gibson is unlocked; nothing tells the table.

shots.heading: After: unlock toast
shots.caption: Every seat gets a corner toast naming the commander and its printed window and ability. It lingers 10 s and stays in the notification history.

shots.heading: Before: lobby page bottom
shots.caption: A player or spectator on a lobby page has no way back to the start screen but the browser's back button.

shots.heading: After: Back to start
shots.caption: Back to start returns to the start screen (create a lobby, My games) without leaving the seat; it is also shown when the game is gone or unreachable.

notes.title: Engine label (no screenshot)
notes.text: Scepter of Dominion's system options (fb_1791905479) now name who would place a command token, or say that nobody would; the generic decision dialog shows the label as before. Labels are not part of the decision record, so replays and decision hashes are unchanged.
